what: Photoderm XDefense 2026 campaign: a man and a woman side by side against a deep-blue sky gradient, Photoderm SPF50+ fluid in front, and a glossy blue-orange liquid sphere on the right.
Hydrabio visual: splash of clear blue gel texture and the Hydrabio range (gel moussant, serum, perfecteur) on the left, dark-haired woman with wind-blown hair on a pale-blue background on the right.
Atoderm visual: woman with glowing bare skin hugging her knees, head resting on her arm, with Atoderm Intensive Baume and Atoderm Huile de Douche pump bottles on the right; warm beige background.
Sensibio H2O hero: the pink-cap micellar water bottle among floating water droplets on the left, close-up of a woman with tied-back hair touching her jaw on the right; soft pearl background.
Sensibio AR+ range (SOS spray, micellar gel, serum, cream) in front of a flowing pink-red silk-like texture, with a freckled red-haired woman in a white top on the right.
Photoderm XDefense sun lifestyle shot: woman in a white tank top with arms raised over her head and eyes closed in sunlight, blue sky and a white modern building behind her. No product.
Vertical version of the Photoderm XDefense sun shoot: woman with arms raised over her head in bright sun, white tank top, blue sky and a white building on the right. High-resolution original.

Pigmentbio square visual: close-up of a freckled woman with slicked-back hair and a braid, Pigmentbio Foaming Cream and Sensitive Areas tubes in the lower right; soft grey background with a faint arc graphic.
